# megaport_mcr_ipsec (Data Source)

Data source for reading the IPsec tunnels on an MCR, grouped by VXC, and the number of tunnels configured. The API does not return pre-shared keys or phase lifetimes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the IPsec tunnels configured on an MCR.
data "megaport_mcr_ipsec" "example" {
  mcr_id = megaport_mcr.example.product_uid
}

output "ipsec_tunnel_count" {
  value = data.megaport_mcr_ipsec.example.total_tunnel_count
}

# Map each VXC UID to the peer addresses of its tunnels.
output "ipsec_tunnel_destinations" {
  value = {
    for vxc in data.megaport_mcr_ipsec.example.vxcs :
    vxc.product_uid => [for tunnel in vxc.tunnels : tunnel.destination_ip_address]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mcr_id` (String) The UID of the MCR to read IPsec tunnels for.

### Read-Only

- `max_tunnel_count_limit` (Number) The highest tunnel count Megaport accepts for the MCR's IPsec add-on. Megaport sets this limit for each MCR, and it is 30 unless Megaport raises it.
- `total_tunnel_count` (Number) The number of IPsec tunnels configured on the MCR, across all its VXCs.
- `vxcs` (Attributes List) The VXCs on the MCR that have at least one IPsec tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vxcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vxcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vxcs`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the VXC.
- `product_uid` (String) The UID of the VXC.
- `tunnels` (Attributes List) The IPsec tunnels configured on the VXC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vxcs--tunnels))

<a id="nestedatt--vxcs--tunnels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vxcs.tunnels`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The description of the tunnel interface.
- `destination_ip_address` (String) Remote peer IP address the tunnel connects to.
- `local_id` (String) IKE local identifier override.
- `remote_id` (String) IKE remote identifier override.
- `source_ip_address` (String) Local (Megaport-side) IP address used as the tunnel source.
- `vlan` (Number) The VLAN of the interface that holds `source_ip_address`. Null when no interface with a VLAN holds that address.
